reference_conventions.coordinates: 1: astrometric ICRF RA/DEC; 31: apparent Earth ecliptic of date IAU76/80
reference_conventions.time: UTC supplied to Horizons as UT post-1962; Swiss UTC-to-TT conversion
reference_conventions.corrections: ICRF astrometric: light-time only, no aberration or solar deflection; apparent ecliptic: light-time, aberration, solar deflection, no atmosphere
reference_conventions.models_notice: ICRF comparison matches reference frame and correction conventions. Apparent of-date comparison retains documented IAU precession/nutation model differences. Swiss file and current JPL minor-body orbit solutions need not be identical.
